concerns.text: T021 (Log-Transform Titers) and T020c (Shannon Diversity) depend on `data/processed/cleared_with_diversity.csv`. However, T020c is listed as producing this file, while T021 is listed as producing it as well, creating a circular or ambiguous dependency. T021 requires `titer_post` which is in `serology.csv` (T012 output), but T020c requires `cleared_default.csv` (T020a output). The merge of microbiome and serology data to create `cleared_with_diversity.csv` is not explicitly defined as a single task preceding both T021 and T020c, risking a 'consumer before producer' violation where T021 tries to read titers from a file that doesn't exist yet.

T034d (Threshold Sweep) depends on T034a (Main Nested CV) and T034b (Null Distribution). The task description states it will 're-run the full inner CV loop (T032 logic)' for each threshold. However, T034d does not explicitly mandate re-running the OUTER fold splits (T031) or re-generating the null distribution (T034b) for each new threshold. Using the same outer splits and null baseline for different responder definitions (thresholds) introduces data leakage and invalidates the robustness check, violating the 'Producer before Consumer' principle for the statistical baseline.

T020b (Pseudocount Sensitivity) is triggered AFTER T022-T024. It re-runs correlation (T022) and BH correction (T023) internally. However, it depends on `filtered_normalized.csv` (T019a output) and requires re-applying T021 (Log-Transform Titers). T021 is listed as a separate task in Phase 4 that produces `cleared_with_diversity.csv`. If T021 has not run or if its output is not accessible to T020b's internal logic, T020b cannot execute. The dependency chain for T020b is ambiguous regarding the source of the log-transformed titers.

T039 (Linting/Formatting) is placed in Phase 6 (Polish) but is marked as a 'Revision & Gap Resolution' item. While not a hard ordering violation, linting is typically a foundational or pre-commit task. Placing it here implies it might be skipped if the pipeline runs successfully without it, which contradicts the 'Setup' phase intent. Consider moving to Phase 1 or marking as a pre-requisite for T045 (Final Report) generation to ensure code quality is verified before final artifact generation.
